column1: # Sweep of the Rosario cathedral baptism index for the given name PABLO ARMANDO under any surname,
# in the years either side of 1882. The 1882 year is complete and recorded in rosario-index-map.tsv.

# constant: a page that is image 55 in the 718-image "Film # 004530325" view is image 52 in the 655-image
# "Indice de bautismos 1879-1900" waypoint view, but near the end of the alphabet the two diverge by
# roughly 56. Image numbers here are therefore LOCATORS ONLY, not evidence, and every page was verified on
# arrival by its letter, year, Libro and folio range - which are stable. The 1881/1883 numbers below are in
# the 655-image waypoint view; the 1882 numbers in rosario-index-map.tsv are in the 718-image film view.
